comment: FHIR’s alignment with web standards is said to make it accessible to a broad implementer ecosystem. Countries may still face substantial shortages of profiling, terminology, security, and implementation expertise.

anchor.note: p.96 l.Lines 321-323 read as the printed page; section 4.3.3 agrees

public.text: FHIR’s alignment with web standards is said to make it accessible to a broad implementer ecosystem. Countries may still face substantial shortages of profiling, terminology, security, and implementation expertise.
public.suggestedRevision: Acknowledge the capacity requirement and recommend reusable implementation guides, reference implementations, regional expertise, training, hosted test services, and gradual adoption.
